stem: ![](asset:P000236-stem-1)Two particles are projected from top of a tower of height 25 m. The speed of projection is 10 m/s for either of them but one is projected at angle of $15{^\circ}$above the horizontal while other at $15{^\circ}$ below as shown. Find the difference in the range of two particles.

assets.alt: From the top of a 25 m tower, two balls are thrown at 10 m/s: one at 15° above the horizontal and one at 15° below it.
